description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for endpoint tests related to a gateway in the Eclipse Ditto project. It sets up test fixtures, mock actors, and utility methods for testing endpoint behavior.

classes.name: EndpointTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for endpoint tests in the gateway service, providing test fixture setup, mock actor creation, and utility methods.

methods.description: Initializes static configuration objects before any tests run.

methods.description: Returns additional configuration to be used in tests.

methods.description: Creates and loads the test configuration from 'test.conf'.
